WORDS: The rocket has left Earth's atmosphere and is on its way to Mars.
It should arrive in several months and deposit the Rover.
The Rover has fully separated from the landing craft and is heading towards Mars' surface.
The landing gear is out and ready.
The Rover will now need to charge before being able to be used again.
